title: Returns & Exchanges Card Refund Amount at Settlement
content:
This settlement worksheet sets the amount paid to the original card or wallet as the final-settlement refund of a Returns & Exchanges return refunded to the original tenders.

## Amount paid to the card

The amount paid to the card is the credit entries on the return, less its fee entries and any refund already paid on it, rounded half up to the cent — and never more than what remains refundable on that card: the amount captured on the card or wallet for the order, less the refunds already made to it for the order and on this return. Any remainder follows the Online Orders tender refund priority to the order's other tenders and is not part of the card refund.

## Where each figure comes from

| Figure | Record |
|---|---|
| Credit entries | The return's credit entries for accepted lines (their full totals) |
| Fee entries | The return's fee entries (restocking, shoebox, return shipping) |
| Refunds already paid on the return | The return's refund entries |
| Captured on the card or wallet, and refunds already made to it for the order | The Online Orders payment records of the order |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Figure | Case A | Case B |
|---|---|---|
| Credit entries | 155.59 | 155.59 |
| Fee entries | 6.95 | 6.95 |
| Refunds already paid on the return | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Owed after fees | 148.64 | 148.64 |
| Remaining refundable on the card | 300.00 | 120.00 |
| Amount paid to the card | 148.64 | 120.00 |
| Remainder to the order's other tenders | None | 28.64 |
